known_limits_recorded.actor_action_map_coverage: 38 of 92 Gold clauses carry an actor_action_map link, so for most clauses the actor side must also be annotated rather than copied
known_limits_recorded.order_relations_in_gold: the published Gold Rule Records carry ZERO order relations across 92 clauses, so the out_of_order decision fields cannot be anchored to existing Gold and would require new annotation of the rules themselves
